name: dsh-version-update
description: Version management for the dsh Web GUI settings panel: inspect the installed @deepseek-ai/dsh against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade with one click, roll back instantly from local snapshots, automate the whole cycle with a policy engine (silent auto-update, execution windows, daily checks), and restart the host seamlessly.
author: SuCriss

scripts.test: node --test test/protocol.test.js test/core.test.js test/policy.test.js test/snapshot.test.js test/history.test.js test/loopback.test.js test/updater.test.js test/scheduler.test.js test/restarter.test.js test/routes.test.js test/index.test.js test/client.test.js
